core-shake-prompt-e-mash-meter.title: Shake prompt + E-mash meter
core-shake-prompt-e-mash-meter.detail: Press E at a tree, mash E for 3 s; 24 counted presses = full meter. Play PASS (v53).

core-drop-odds-per-tree-class-full-meter.title: Drop odds per tree class + full-meter boost
core-drop-odds-per-tree-class-full-meter.detail: Common tree 85/13/2, Uncommon 55/40/5, Rare 35/50/15. Full meter: Uncommon ×3, Rare ×5.

core-claw-branch-chase-catch-and-escape.title: Claw-branch chase, catch and escape
core-claw-branch-chase-catch-and-escape.detail: Tree roars, claw bursts from the canopy and chases the thief. Catch within 4 studs, homes in within 14 studs. Safe zone ends the chase.

core-carry-monster-and-deposit-at-base.title: Carry monster and deposit at base
core-carry-monster-and-deposit-at-base.detail: Carried monsters shrink to max 5 studs and are restored on deposit. Deposit adds the monster to your base income.

core-shake-ui-v2-big-e-key-rising-bar-gr.title: Shake UI v2: big E key, rising bar, graded pop-ups
core-shake-ui-v2-big-e-key-rising-bar-gr.detail: Not Bad! (red) / Good! (orange) / Great! (yellow) / Perfect! (green, full meter only). Written locally; the push into Studio was cut off by the usage limit. Check it's in Studio, preview, then save the place.

core-guarantee-a-drop-on-a-player-s-very.title: Guarantee a drop on a player's very first shake
core-guarantee-a-drop-on-a-player-s-very.detail: A new player's first shake always drops a monster, so the first 30 seconds end in a win.

core-easier-first-2-3-chases-for-new-pla.title: Easier first 2–3 chases for new players
core-easier-first-2-3-chases-for-new-pla.detail: Slower claw or a closer safe zone for a player's first few steals. Being caught on the first try makes people leave.

core-re-balance-escape-after-14-stud-hom.title: Re-balance escape after 14-stud homing and 1.5× players
core-re-balance-escape-after-14-stud-hom.detail: Homing made escapes harder. Re-run the escape test (earlier sim: ~12-stud gap at WalkSpeed 16) with real avatars.

core-pity-monster-when-a-new-player-is-c.title: Pity monster when a new player is caught
core-pity-monster-when-a-new-player-is-c.detail: If a new player gets caught, the tree still drops a small monster so they win something.

core-shake-together-friends-fill-the-met.title: Shake together: friends fill the meter faster
core-shake-together-friends-fill-the-met.detail: Two or more friends mashing the same tree share one meter, fill it faster and get better luck.

core-decoy-play-a-friend-distracts-the-c.title: Decoy play: a friend distracts the claw
core-decoy-play-a-friend-distracts-the-c.detail: The claw targets the nearest player, so one friend can pull it away while the other runs with the monster.

tree-block-guardian-style-locked-as-main.title: Block Guardian style locked as main tree style
tree-block-guardian-style-locked-as-main.detail: Cubes with ground stud material, ~68 studs tall, sleeping face with z's, angry when shaken, stepped canopy, roots in the ground. Backup in ServerStorage.

tree-eyes-follow-the-player-claw-always-.title: Eyes follow the player, claw always faces the player
tree-eyes-follow-the-player-claw-always-.detail: Pupils track your head while awake; claw turns toward the chased player.

tree-decide-rebuild-the-3-protected-fore.title: Decide: rebuild the 3 protected Forest trees in Block Guardian style?
tree-decide-rebuild-the-3-protected-fore.detail: The 6 older trees are smooth/realistic; the locked style is blocky. Replacing the protected Forest trees needs the owner's OK.

tree-thumbnail-ready-hero-shot-of-an-ang.title: Thumbnail-ready hero shot of an angry Block Guardian
tree-thumbnail-ready-hero-shot-of-an-ang.detail: Pose the Candy tree mid-chase with a player carrying a monster; use it for the icon and thumbnails.

zone-forest-grove-applewood-guardian.title: Forest Grove: Applewood Guardian
zone-forest-grove-applewood-guardian.detail: Placed as decoration only. Too dark from the path. Make shakeable or rebuild.

zone-forest-grove-crystal-thornwood.title: Forest Grove: Crystal Thornwood
zone-forest-grove-crystal-thornwood.detail: Placed as decoration only. Make shakeable or rebuild.

zone-forest-grove-8-forest-monsters.title: Forest Grove: 8 Forest monsters
zone-forest-grove-8-forest-monsters.detail: Leafling, Bunfruit, MushroomBuddy, Frogstump, Brambleboar, Glimmerdeer, Rockmoss, Wispfox.

zone-candy-canopy-candy-rare-tree.title: Candy Canopy: Candy Rare tree
zone-candy-canopy-candy-rare-tree.detail: Biggest shape with a crown silhouette.

zone-candy-canopy-candy-monster-set.title: Candy Canopy: Candy monster set
zone-candy-canopy-candy-monster-set.detail: None yet: the Candy tree drops Forest monsters for now.

zone-sandy-orchard-sunleaf-palm.title: Sandy Orchard: Sunleaf Palm
zone-sandy-orchard-sunleaf-palm.detail: Decoration only. Rebuild in Block Guardian style and make shakeable.

zone-sandy-orchard-blossom-canopy.title: Sandy Orchard: Blossom Canopy
zone-sandy-orchard-blossom-canopy.detail: Decoration only. Rebuild and make shakeable.

zone-sandy-orchard-amber-sunwood.title: Sandy Orchard: Amber Sunwood
zone-sandy-orchard-amber-sunwood.detail: Decoration only. Rebuild and make shakeable.

zone-icy-thicket-icy-common-tree.title: Icy Thicket: Icy Common tree
zone-icy-thicket-icy-common-tree.detail: Ship this zone as a post-launch update; each update gets tested on new players.

zone-icy-thicket-icy-uncommon-tree.title: Icy Thicket: Icy Uncommon tree
zone-icy-thicket-icy-uncommon-tree.detail: Ship this zone as a post-launch update; each update gets tested on new players.

zone-icy-thicket-icy-rare-tree.title: Icy Thicket: Icy Rare tree
zone-icy-thicket-icy-rare-tree.detail: Ship this zone as a post-launch update; each update gets tested on new players.

zone-volcanic-woods-volcanic-common-tree.title: Volcanic Woods: Volcanic Common tree
zone-volcanic-woods-volcanic-common-tree.detail: Ship this zone as a post-launch update; each update gets tested on new players.

zone-volcanic-woods-volcanic-uncommon-tr.title: Volcanic Woods: Volcanic Uncommon tree
zone-volcanic-woods-volcanic-uncommon-tr.detail: Ship this zone as a post-launch update; each update gets tested on new players.

zone-volcanic-woods-volcanic-rare-tree.title: Volcanic Woods: Volcanic Rare tree
zone-volcanic-woods-volcanic-rare-tree.detail: Ship this zone as a post-launch update; each update gets tested on new players.

zone-cosmic-orchard-cosmic-common-tree.title: Cosmic Orchard: Cosmic Common tree
zone-cosmic-orchard-cosmic-common-tree.detail: Ship this zone as a post-launch update; each update gets tested on new players.

zone-cosmic-orchard-cosmic-uncommon-tree.title: Cosmic Orchard: Cosmic Uncommon tree
zone-cosmic-orchard-cosmic-uncommon-tree.detail: Ship this zone as a post-launch update; each update gets tested on new players.

zone-cosmic-orchard-cosmic-rare-tree.title: Cosmic Orchard: Cosmic Rare tree
zone-cosmic-orchard-cosmic-rare-tree.detail: Ship this zone as a post-launch update; each update gets tested on new players.

zone-all-6-zones-built-blocky-trench-sty.title: All 6 zones built (Blocky Trench style)
zone-all-6-zones-built-blocky-trench-sty.detail: Forest, Sandy, Candy, Icy, Volcanic, Cosmic (v46).

zone-spawn-new-players-facing-a-common-t.title: Spawn new players facing a Common tree a few steps away
zone-spawn-new-players-facing-a-common-t.detail: No walking around to find the game. The first tree is visible from spawn.

zone-zone-unlock-path.title: Zone unlock path
zone-zone-unlock-path.detail: Each zone unlocks with coins/progress so there's always a next goal inside the first hour.

mons-scale-monsters-up-to-match-1-5-play.title: Scale monsters up to match 1.5× players
mons-scale-monsters-up-to-match-1-5-play.detail: At 1.5× players, monsters look a third smaller. You flagged small monsters twice before.

mons-play-test-the-big-monster-sizes.title: Play-test the big monster sizes
mons-play-test-the-big-monster-sizes.detail: Sizes from v58 were only checked in Edit.

mons-monster-index-collection-book-per-z.title: Monster Index (collection book per zone)
mons-monster-index-collection-book-per-z.detail: "Collect all 8 Forest monsters" gives a long-term goal and a reason to come back.

mons-golden-shiny-monster-variants.title: Golden / shiny monster variants
mons-golden-shiny-monster-variants.detail: Rare variant with extra income. A collection goal that brings players back.

econ-income-per-second-per-monster-appro.title: Income per second per monster (approved set A)

econ-base-storage-10-20-slots-with-upgra.title: Base storage 10 → 20 slots with upgrades
econ-base-storage-10-20-slots-with-upgra.detail: 12 (10K), 14 (50K), 16 (200K), 18 (750K), 20 (2.5M). Full base auto-swaps the weakest. Save/rejoin PASS.

econ-show-income-per-second-on-the-hud-a.title: Show income per second on the HUD again
econ-show-income-per-second-on-the-hud-a.detail: Removed in the HUD redesign. Watching income grow keeps players playing.

econ-offline-earnings-with-a-collect-mom.title: Offline earnings with a Collect moment on return
econ-offline-earnings-with-a-collect-mom.detail: Monsters keep earning while away, capped at a few hours. Show a big Collect screen on rejoin.

econ-plan-the-first-60-minutes-of-goals.title: Plan the first 60 minutes of goals
econ-plan-the-first-60-minutes-of-goals.detail: e.g. 0–5 min first deposit, ~15 min storage upgrade, ~30 min next zone, ~60 min first Rare. Only 60 min/day count.

econ-speed-upgrade-path.title: Speed upgrade path
econ-speed-upgrade-path.detail: Decide how speed is earned/upgraded and how it interacts with chase balance.

econ-rebirth-system.title: Rebirth system
econ-rebirth-system.detail: Reset progress for a permanent multiplier: long-term goal for players past the first week.

uihu-hud-layout-v64-shop-index-left-mons.title: HUD layout v64: Shop/Index left, Monsters right, money + speed bottom-left
uihu-hud-layout-v64-shop-index-left-mons.detail: New cartoon money and speed icons, no backgrounds.

uihu-phone-layout-pass.title: Phone layout pass
uihu-phone-layout-pass.detail: Money/speed sit near the thumbstick; check on a real phone.

uihu-index-menu-ui.title: Index menu UI
uihu-index-menu-ui.detail: Shows collected / missing monsters per zone.

onbo-no-menus-or-long-loading-before-pla.title: No menus or long loading before play
onbo-no-menus-or-long-loading-before-pla.detail: Spawn straight into the world; no Play button, no settings screen.

onbo-guide-arrow-tree-shake-run-base.title: Guide arrow: tree → shake → run → base
onbo-guide-arrow-tree-shake-run-base.detail: A bouncing arrow/highlight instead of text walls. Disappears after the first deposit.

onbo-onboarding-funnel-analytics.title: Onboarding funnel analytics
onbo-onboarding-funnel-analytics.detail: AnalyticsService onboarding steps: Joined → FirstShake → FirstDrop → FirstEscape → FirstDeposit. Shows exactly where new players quit.

onbo-first-deposit-celebration.title: First-deposit celebration
onbo-first-deposit-celebration.detail: Coins tick up immediately with a sound and burst after the first deposit.

rete-daily-reward-streak-with-countdown.title: Daily reward streak with countdown
rete-daily-reward-streak-with-countdown.detail: 7-day cycle, "next reward in HH:MM:SS", streak freezes. Port the logic from src/server/Services/DailyReturn.luau.

rete-playtime-gifts-up-to-60-active-minu.title: Playtime gifts up to 60 active minutes
rete-playtime-gifts-up-to-60-active-minu.detail: Stops at 60 because Roblox only counts 60 min/day. Port from PlaytimeGoals.luau.

rete-golden-tree-once-per-day.title: Golden Tree once per day
rete-golden-tree-once-per-day.detail: A special tree appears once a day with much better drops.

rete-lucky-zone-of-the-day.title: Lucky Zone of the day
rete-lucky-zone-of-the-day.detail: One zone has boosted Rare odds today, rotating daily.

rete-server-events-every-15-20-minutes.title: Server events every 15–20 minutes
rete-server-events-every-15-20-minutes.detail: "Monster Rain", "All trees wake up!": reasons to stay in the session.

rete-tomorrow-s-tree-preview.title: Tomorrow's tree preview
rete-tomorrow-s-tree-preview.detail: End of session shows a locked silhouette that unlocks tomorrow.

rete-opt-in-reminder-notifications.title: Opt-in reminder notifications
rete-opt-in-reminder-notifications.detail: Prompt after a reward claim; create templates in Creator Hub; send "your earnings are ready".

rete-28-day-seasons.title: 28-day seasons
rete-28-day-seasons.detail: Four weekly chapters ending on day 28, matching the algorithm's window.

soci-invite-button.title: Invite button
soci-invite-button.detail: SocialService invite prompt with a short message.

soci-friend-bonus-more-income-luck-with-.title: Friend bonus: more income/luck with friends in the server
soci-friend-bonus-more-income-luck-with-.detail: +10% per friend, capped. Port from CoPlay.luau.

soci-free-private-servers.title: Free private servers
soci-free-private-servers.detail: Set the private server price to 0 in Creator Hub. Private servers count as co-play.

soci-invite-rewards-for-inviter-and-join.title: Invite rewards for inviter and joiner

soci-spawn-friends-next-to-each-other.title: Spawn friends next to each other
soci-spawn-friends-next-to-each-other.detail: When someone joins by following a friend, spawn them near that friend.

mone-safe-purchase-handling-processrecei.title: Safe purchase handling (ProcessReceipt)
mone-safe-purchase-handling-processrecei.detail: Save the receipt before granting; never double-grant. See Monetization.luau.

mone-luck-potion-15-min.title: Luck Potion (15 min)
mone-luck-potion-15-min.detail: Cheap, repeatable developer product: better drop odds for 15 minutes.

mone-speed-boost.title: Speed Boost
mone-speed-boost.detail: Cheap, repeatable developer product. Must not make the chase trivial.

mone-rotating-daily-deal.title: Rotating daily deal
mone-rotating-daily-deal.detail: One cheap product changes every day: more spend days, less pressure.

data-review-saving-for-dupes-session-loc.title: Review saving for dupes: session lock + BindToClose
data-review-saving-for-dupes-session-loc.detail: Player rejoining another server before the save lands can dupe monsters. Compare with PlayerData.luau.

vfxa-forgegui-particle-sprites-bark.title: ForgeGUI particle sprites + bark
vfxa-forgegui-particle-sprites-bark.detail: Leaf, dust puff, sparkle, wood chip sprites; branch bark texture.

vfxa-forgegui-sound-batch.title: ForgeGUI sound batch
vfxa-forgegui-sound-batch.detail: Rustle, pop, snap, roar, whoosh, escape jingle.

vfxa-track-forgegui-credit-balance.title: Track ForgeGUI credit balance
vfxa-track-forgegui-credit-balance.detail: ForgeGUI doesn't report per-call cost; check the account page.

perf-performance-pass-v57.title: Performance pass (v57)
perf-performance-pass-v57.detail: Shadows trimmed, 6,123 hidden textures and 124 lights removed, streaming radius 512.

perf-phone-fps-test-during-a-shake.title: Phone FPS test during a shake
perf-phone-fps-test-during-a-shake.detail: The shake moves ~150 parts per frame.

perf-mobile-tap-controls-test.title: Mobile TAP controls test
perf-mobile-tap-controls-test.detail: Shake button, prompts, carry, deposit on touch.

perf-fast-first-load.title: Fast first load
perf-fast-first-load.detail: Keep the spawn area light; confirm StreamingEnabled settings.

test-multiplayer-test-with-2-4-players.title: Multiplayer test with 2–4 players
test-multiplayer-test-with-2-4-players.detail: Stealing, chases, storage and deposit with several players at once. Never tested yet.

test-fresh-account-first-5-minutes-test-.title: Fresh-account first-5-minutes test before every release
test-fresh-account-first-5-minutes-test-.detail: Play as a brand-new account on a phone before publishing.

tool-put-the-project-under-git-and-push-.title: Put the project under git and push to GitHub
tool-put-the-project-under-git-and-push-.detail: The project folder isn't a git repo. Push to gioalee2008-wq/Shake-A-Mo.

tool-save-local-copies-of-studio-only-sc.title: Save local copies of Studio-only scripts
tool-save-local-copies-of-studio-only-sc.detail: LoopConfig, Lib.Monsters, CarryService, DepositService exist only in Studio.

tool-start-a-fresh-claude-session-from-t.title: Start a fresh Claude session from the handoff docs
tool-start-a-fresh-claude-session-from-t.detail: The old session is 68% full and stopped mid-task.

tool-rojo-sync-between-files-and-studio.title: Rojo sync between files and Studio

stor-custom-icon.title: Custom icon
stor-custom-icon.detail: An angry guardian tree face and a monster. Readable at phone size.

stor-3-5-thumbnails-of-the-chase-moment.title: 3–5 thumbnails of the chase moment
stor-3-5-thumbnails-of-the-chase-moment.detail: Claw chasing a player who carries a monster. No custom thumbnail = no recommendations.

stor-title-and-description-check.title: Title and description check
stor-title-and-description-check.detail: Keep "Shake a Monster Tree!"; describe the loop in one line.

stor-promise-match-test.title: Promise-match test
stor-promise-match-test.detail: Put the thumbnail beside a frame from the first 10 s of play. They must look like the same game.

stor-a-b-test-thumbnails.title: A/B test thumbnails
stor-a-b-test-thumbnails.detail: One change at a time, at least 7 days each.

anal-session-length-buckets.title: Session length buckets
anal-session-length-buckets.detail: <1 min / 1–3 min / stayed, as custom events.

anal-weekly-check-of-the-discovery-signa.title: Weekly check of the discovery signals
anal-weekly-check-of-the-discovery-signa.detail: Creator Hub > Analytics. Note the weakest signal and fix it next.

laun-small-sponsored-ad-test.title: Small Sponsored ad test
laun-small-sponsored-ad-test.detail: Paid players don't count toward the signals, but they show quickly whether new players bounce.

laun-fix-wherever-the-onboarding-funnel-.title: Fix wherever the onboarding funnel drops most

laun-update-every-1-2-weeks.title: Update every 1–2 weeks
laun-update-every-1-2-weeks.detail: New zone, monsters or event. Roblox re-tests games on new players after updates.

laun-watch-signals-for-7-days-after-each.title: Watch signals for 7 days after each update
laun-watch-signals-for-7-days-after-each.detail: If bounce rises, fix onboarding first.
